periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation angled downwards and outwards from the midline of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a primary vertical-oblique axis longer than the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering towards the lateral-inferior edge.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior profile with a relatively flat transition across the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness occupying approximately 50% of the visible upper torso region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance between dark regions is approximately equal to the horizontal width of one ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and rounded semicircular profile.
